# Test fixtures: provenance

- `iscan_sample.csv`: 12 rows of the IOSCO I-SCAN CSV export downloaded on 2026-10-12
  (https://www.iosco.org/i-scan/). Public information submitted by IOSCO members; reproduced
  unchanged for testing, with attribution.
- `consob_index_sample.html`: nine press releases from the CONSOB page "Ordini di oscuramento di
  siti abusivi" (https://www.consob.it/web/area-pubblica/oscuramenti), retrieved on 2026-10-14.
  Source: CONSOB. Reproduced unchanged for documentation and testing, as the CONSOB legal notice
  allows with attribution.
- `fca_feed_synthetic.xml`: **synthetic**. It copies the structure of the FCA warnings RSS feed;
  names, domains and numbers are invented. The FCA terms do not allow redistributing saved copies
  of its pages.
